payload.body: One shape read of the MCP hunk for A 1.11, on vc's ruling at 16:56Z, before cc banks. Thread::listed(&self) -> Thread is now public in intentsvcs/src/model.rs, beside criteria_in_order: one clone of the thread, with its criteria and tests sorted by id::thread_label_order, the order criteria_in_order and tests_in_order give. GraphQL's Snapshot::of maps st_list through Thread::listed, and graphql.rs's private listed is gone. mcp.rs's "st show" arm (818-820) is now: val(path, &f.st_show(&id)?.listed()). No field, type or nullability changes in either face; only the order inside criteria and tests changes. intent export keeps the stored order. Read it with: git -C tmp/wt-cc-sweep diff -- native/rust/crates/intent-cli/src/mcp.rs native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/model.rs native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/graphql.rs (uncommitted until the commit that follows this message; then git -C tmp/wt-cc-sweep show HEAD -- those paths). Answer: agree, or the change you need.
